title: Finite affine representing charts for the Frobenius kernel
statement: Let p be prime, S a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme over F_p [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], E a finite locally free O_S-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], and F an additive endomorphism of its lifted tensor-section etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] satisfying F(as)=a^p F(s) on every etale object. There is a finite affine open cover W_a of S and, on each chart, an affine etale scheme P_a→W_a whose represented set sheaf is isomorphic to the underlying set sheaf of the abelian inverse image of ker(F-1).

proof.text: Take a natural finite coordinate neighbourhood of each point of S from the local-coordinate lemma, with U=S and identity structure map. For its matrix apply the polynomial solution theorem with zero target. This produces an affine etale P→W with the universal fixed tuple.

Evaluation preserves the categorical kernel of abelian sheaves. Lift the universal fixed section to the kernel, and use Yoneda to obtain a natural map from h_P to its underlying set sheaf. For any etale V→W, the quotient universal property gives surjectivity on sections. Uniqueness of the map to P gives injectivity. Thus it is a sheaf isomorphism. Restriction preserves kernels and agrees with abelian inverse image along the open immersion.
Quasi-compactness extracts a finite subcover of these affine coordinate neighbourhoods; reindex the chosen finite set by Fin n. Empty S gives n=0.

theorem frobenius_vectorBundle_affine_kernel_models
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [S.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p))))] [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (F : (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E) ⟶
      (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E))
    (hF : ∀ (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
        (e : ULift.{u + 1} Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)),
      F.hom.app U (ULift.up (a.down • e.down)) =
        ULift.up (a.down ^ p • (@id Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)
          (F.hom.app U e).down))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → S.Opens),
      (∀ a, IsAffineOpen (W a)) ∧
      (⋃ a : Fin n, (W a : Set S)) = Set.univ ∧
      ∀ a, ∃ (P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ (W a).toScheme),
        IsAffine P ∧ ∃ _ : Etale π, Nonempty
          ((sheafCompose _ (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (W a).ι).obj
              (kernel (F - 𝟙 _))) ≅
                ((W a).toScheme.smallEtaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}).obj (Etale.mk π))
